name: nundar
description: Open-source commerce engine for Cloudflare. SEO-first, multilingual, single-tenant.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Stripe **secret key** (`sk_live_…` or `sk_test_…`), from [Stripe → Developers → API keys](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys). Leave blank to deploy the storefront without payments — you can add it later with `wrangler secret put`.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret (`whsec_…`) of the Stripe webhook you point at `https://yourdomain.com/api/webhooks/stripe` subscribing to `payment_intent.succeeded`. **Order status depends on this** — without it, paid orders never leave `pending`.

MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Address order emails are sent from, e.g. `orders@yourdomain.com`. The domain must be onboarded first: `npx wrangler email sending enable yourdomain.com`.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Your public site address, e.g. `https://yourdomain.com`. Canonical URLs and hreflang are built from it, so **getting this wrong breaks SEO** — it must be the real domain, not the workers.dev URL.

DB.description: D1 database holding products, orders and customers. Created for you.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for product images. Created for you.

NEXT_INC_CACHE_R2_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket backing incremental static regeneration. Created for you.

SESSIONS.description: KV namespace for admin sessions, guest carts and rate limiting. Created for you.

scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute nundar --local --file=./drizzle/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: pnpm db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./drizzle/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:local && opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm db:migrate:remote && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
